name: Prayer (Salah)

definition_by_age.4: Talking to Allah at special times of day.
definition_by_age.6: Salah is how Muslims pray five times a day to connect with Allah.
definition_by_age.8: Salah is a structured, five-times-daily act of worship that connects us to Allah with focus and calm (khushu).

learning_objective: Children can name one of the five daily prayers.

recommended_default.note: Added 2026-08-05 during conflict/pattern expansion — real conflict now exists for this concept, closing a prior retrieval-diversity gap.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Skipping prayer to keep watching something is a live temptation/choice.
